title: Personal Credit Cards: minimum payment percent, minimum payment floor and due date by tier
content:
# Personal Credit Cards: minimum payment and due date terms

This quick reference covers the Personal Credit Cards line and gives, for every card tier, the percent of the new statement balance included in the minimum payment, the floor below which the minimum payment never falls, and the number of calendar days from the statement closing date to the payment due date.

## Tier table

| Card tier | Percent of new statement balance in the minimum payment | Minimum payment floor | Days from statement closing date to due date |
|---|---|---|---|
| Secured Visa | 1.00% | 25.00 USD | 25 calendar days |
| College Rewards Visa | 1.00% | 25.00 USD | 25 calendar days |
| Platinum Low Rate Visa | 1.00% | 35.00 USD | 25 calendar days |
| Cash Rewards Visa | 1.00% | 35.00 USD | 25 calendar days |
| Travel Rewards Visa Signature | 1.00% | 35.00 USD | 25 calendar days |
| Visa Infinite Private Client | 1.00% | 35.00 USD | 25 calendar days |

## What the columns mean

- **Percent of the new statement balance**: the percent of the new statement balance included in the minimum payment, in addition to the interest and fees billed.
- **Minimum payment floor**: the minimum payment is never below this amount, unless the statement balance is smaller.
- **Days to due date**: calendar days counted from the statement closing date to the payment due date.

## Worked illustration (hypothetical dates)

A hypothetical statement that closes on 3 June has its payment due date 25 calendar days later, on 28 June. The count is in calendar days, so weekends inside the period are counted like any other day.

## Basis Q&A

**Q: Which tiers use the lower floor?**
A: Secured Visa and College Rewards Visa, with a floor of 25.00 USD; the other four tiers use 35.00 USD.
